newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT cut to attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT cut to attractive.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Jason Ader said in a research note that he cut his rating on ITT Corp to attractive from buy.
-- The analyst's note confirms an earlier item attributed to a Bear Stearns source.
-- Also, a market source said Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette downgraded the stock to outperform from buy while a source at Smith Barney said the firm too cut its ITT rating, to neutral from buy.
-- In the Bear Stearns research note, Ader said the main reason for the downgrade is "the liklihood of significant construction disruption through the end of 1997 in Las Vegas and Atlantic City."

-- After the market close Monday, ITT said its third quarter earnings will be reduced to about even with the year-ago $0.56 per share -- under Wall Street estimates -- because of lower-than expected performance in its gaming operations.
-- The stock was untraded on the New York Stock Exchange because of a trading imbalance, but was bid 48, asked 51.
-- Ader lowered his third quarter earnings estimate to $0.56 per share from $0.84, the fourth quarter to $0.76 per share from $0.78 and the 1996 estimate to $2.30 per share from $2.60.

-- "The main reason for the earnings shortfall was that baccarat revenues in Las Vegas weere down sharply. It is important to note that this is not a Las Vegas gaming market problem. Baccarat results at Mirage (Resorts Inc ) and MGM (Grand Inc ) are very strong," according to Ader.
